name: L10 PanoLab positive-calibrated open-set appearance abstention
question: Does the pre-materialization dual score-and-margin gate retain all four consumed positive candidates while rejecting all four pixel-unseen, human-reviewed, geospatially excluded negative queries as UNKNOWN?

open_set_contract.calibration_source: The four source-extended positive episodes in l10_panolab_component_router_result_v1.json; all were consumed Development before this negative source was selected.
open_set_contract.threshold_rule: Set each threshold to the minimum corresponding value across the four correct positive-roster queries, with no negative examples and no search over alternative statistics.
open_set_contract.accept: Emit APPEARANCE_SEARCH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE only if both the top-1 facade-fingerprint score and top-1-minus-runner-up margin meet their frozen minima; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
open_set_contract.semantics: This is a tiny positive-calibrated selective Development rule. It is not conformal calibration, does not control FDR, and has no distribution-shift guarantee.

observation_window.anchor: strict OSM entrance ray under the unchanged zero-pose Panoramax contract
observation_window.sampling: native equirectangular pixels with horizontal seam wrap and no resampling

execution.backend_rule: Use the existing project CPU/CUDA representative probe once, then keep its selected backend for all twelve crops.
execution.overwrite: Refuse an existing output or artifact root.
execution.one_shot: Run the frozen negative evaluator once. Do not change thresholds, score formula, reference bank, crop, or panel after observing negative outcomes.

research_basis.title: SafeVPR: Patch-Based Conformal Verification for Safe Cross-Condition Sequence Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates a separate accept/abstain layer over patch-aware retrieval. This evaluator reuses its already frozen mutual-patch score but does not implement sequence DTW, conformal calibration, LTT, or FDR guarantees.

research_basis.title: Through the Lens of Doubt: Robust and Efficient Uncertainty Estimation for Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates score separation as a training-free ambiguity signal. This evaluator uses only the top-1 score and margin fixed from four positives and claims no benchmark equivalence.

claim_boundary.allowed: Fresh-negative Development evidence about whether one pre-frozen positive-calibrated score-and-margin rule abstains on four exact-roster-absent Panoramax entrance-ray queries while retaining the four consumed positives by construction.
not_allowed: fresh positive recognition, open-world generalization, conformal validity, FDR control, calibrated probability, or arbitrary distribution-shift robustness
an accepted appearance candidate being exact-instance, address, facade, sign, door, portal, or entrance ownership
appearance authorizing the independently projected OSM entrance ray
entrance affordance, public or legal access, walkability, collision-free traversability, waypoint accuracy, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
